dialogues.speaker: Speaker's Chamber Announcement
dialogues.text: "Today is the Speaker's Chamber Question-and-Answer Day. Please leave your queries here in an orderly fashion, and our Pyro Archon will answer them in order."

dialogues.speaker: Guest Message
dialogues.text: "Big Sis Lady Mavuika! What are your glasses made of? Why don't they get burned by fire? I asked Dad, Mom, and Big Sis, but none of them know..."

dialogues.speaker: Pyro Archon's Reply
dialogues.text: "My sunglasses? I had 'em custom-made from Xilonen. If you want a pair, too, kiddo, you can ask her. I'm sure she's happy to help."

dialogues.speaker: Another Guest's Message
dialogues.text: "Lady Archon. I'm an athlete, but I've been in subpar form lately, and a breakthrough has eluded me constantly."

dialogues.speaker: Another Guest's Message
dialogues.text: "...I sometimes wonder if I simply... lack talent. If I should give up. Dear Archon, could you give me some advice?"

dialogues.speaker: Pyro Archon's Reply
dialogues.text: "If you wish to gain fame and wealth through 'sport,' then I urge you to work within your limits and be realistic about your chances."

dialogues.speaker: Pyro Archon's Reply
dialogues.text: "If you're in this line because you love it, however, keep pushing on."

dialogues.speaker: Pyro Archon's Reply
dialogues.text: "The sweat you have poured out and the pain you've endured will serve as the stepping stones toward your victory."
